name: Relay coil with diode and LED
summary: A relay assembly with diode and LED combines coil transient suppression and a visible energisation indicator.
description: A relay assembly with diode and LED combines coil transient suppression and a visible energisation indicator. The schematic must identify both auxiliary functions without treating the LED as proof of contact movement.
readingNotes: The indicator reports its own electrical condition, not necessarily the mechanical contact state.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: An illuminated coil indicator is different from an auxiliary contact confirming device position.
